# FunMel

**From fungal confrontation photographs to matched-control results.**

FunMel measures the colour, shape and image-darkness profiles of
approximately round *Zymoseptoria tritici* colonies around another
fungus. It separates target colonies from central fungal tissue and
connected hyphal growth, preserves image provenance and custom metadata,
and compares treatments with their own set controls.

**[Get started](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/articles/FunMel.html) ·
[Real 14-day
tutorial](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/articles/Real-14-day.html) ·
[All function
examples](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/articles/Function-examples.html)**

## Install

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mghotbi/FunMel")
```

Restart R before loading an updated package. R \>= 4.1 and
source-compilation tools are required: Xcode Command Line Tools on
macOS, matching Rtools on Windows, or R development tools and
ImageMagick development libraries on Linux. For installed tutorials, use
`build_vignettes=TRUE` during installation.

## Quick start with your photographs

The ZIP is an input file; the project is a separate output folder.
Replace these paths with your own. This block reopens a recognized
project and reads saved measurements; otherwise it prepares and measures
a new project.

``` r

library(FunMel)
photo_zip <- path.expand("~/Desktop/photos_14_days.zip")
project_dir <- path.expand("~/Desktop/My_FunMel_project")

if (file.exists(file.path(project_dir, "project.rds"))) {
  project <- load_experiment(project_dir)
} else {
  project <- prepare_experiment(input=photo_zip, project_dir=project_dir)
}

if (file.exists(project$result_file) || file.exists(project$reviewed_file)) {
  result <- read_experiment(project)
} else {
  result <- run_experiment(
    project, dish_diameter_mm=90, # Replace with the verified outer dish diameter.
    n_spots=5, spot_radius_mm=0.4
  )
}
result$failed
head(result$colonies)
project$qc_dir # Inspect the saved QC images and resolve failures first.

reviewed <- finish_experiment(project)
comparison <- plot_treatment_comparison(reviewed)
if (!is.null(comparison)) print(comparison)
project$project_dir # Saved tables and any eligible comparison figures.
```

A new project needs a new or empty output folder. Reopening retains that
project’s photographs; choose another folder for a different archive. To
change analysis settings, rerun
[`run_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/run_experiment.md)
explicitly. The default layout is four target colonies around a central
fungus. Control-only images need `default_centre="none"`; mixed
collections need correct per-image layouts.

Measurement needs no treatment names or approval-flag edits. A treatment
comparison still requires real treatment/control assignments within each
`set_id`. Otherwise FunMel saves measurements, reports `awaiting_design`
and explains why no comparison figure is produced. The real-data
tutorial also shows a descriptive set plot that needs no treatment
names.

The output folder also contains `run_summary.csv`,
`metadata_issues.csv`, `measurement_issues.csv` and
`layout_assignments.csv`. These distinguish missing experimental
assignments from incomplete colony/spot measurements. See the [real-data
troubleshooting
guide](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/articles/Real-14-day.html#when-coefficient-tables-are-empty).

## Interpretation

Melanization index is `MI = 100 - CIELAB L*`: an image-darkness proxy,
not a direct measurement of melanin concentration. Central hyphal growth
is not an inhibition zone. Inspect masks, calibration and lighting
before interpreting results.

Independent plates are the experimental units; colonies and spots are
subsamples. Matched coefficients divide treatment plate means by their
own set’s control mean. One control per set supports descriptive ratios,
not replicated-control significance tests. The tutorials explain
statistical requirements, figure contents and limitations in detail.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`analyze_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/analyze_plate.md)
  : Analyse one plate photograph

- [`analyze_plates()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/analyze_plates.md)
  : Analyse many plates

- [`annotate_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/annotate_plate.md)
  : Interactively annotate training regions

- [`assess_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/assess_experiment.md)
  : Assess matched treatment effects within and across control sets

- [`calibrate_color()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/calibrate_color.md)
  : Colour / exposure calibration against a reference patch

- [`classify_pixels()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/classify_pixels.md)
  : Classify target colonies and central fungal growth

- [`colony_profiles()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/colony_profiles.md)
  : Edge-to-centre melanization profiles

- [`compare_melanization()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/compare_melanization.md)
  : Compare colony measurements while accounting for plates

- [`correct_facing_bias()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/correct_facing_bias.md)
  : Remove position-specific lighting bias from side-specific metrics

- [`delta_e76()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/delta_e76.md)
  :

  Colour difference CIE76 (Euclidean distance in L*a*b\*)

- [`detect_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/detect_plate.md)
  : Detect the Petri dish and set the spatial scale

- [`example_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/example_experiment.md)
  : Reproducible synthetic matched-set experiment for learning the
  workflow

- [`example_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/example_plate.md)
  : Paths to the example plate photographs shipped with FunMel

- [`extract_training_pixels()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/extract_training_pixels.md)
  : Extract annotated training pixels

- [`finalize_analysis()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/finalize_analysis.md)
  : Finalize saved measurements after reviewing metadata and image masks

- [`finish_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/finish_experiment.md)
  : Finalize a prepared experiment after plate review

- [`is_funmel_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/is_funmel_plate.md)
  : Test for a FunMel plate object

- [`is_mycohalo_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/is_mycohalo_plate.md)
  : Check a plate object (compatibility name from MycoHalo)

- [`lab_chroma_hue()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/lab_chroma_hue.md)
  : Chroma and hue angle from a\* and b\*

- [`lab_to_srgb()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/lab_to_srgb.md)
  :

  Convert CIE L*a*b\* to sRGB

- [`layout_by_treatment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/layout_by_treatment.md)
  : Choose a segmentation layout from one metadata row

- [`load_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/load_experiment.md)
  : Open an existing experiment in its current folder

- [`make_metadata()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/make_metadata.md)
  : Create a metadata template for matched treatment-control sets

- [`measure_colonies()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/measure_colonies.md)
  : Measure colonies: size, shape, melanization and interaction metrics

- [`melanization_coefficient()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/melanization_coefficient.md)
  : Calculate the treatment-to-control melanization coefficient

- [`model_background()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/model_background.md)
  : Model the agar background and correct uneven illumination

- [`plate_layout()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/plate_layout.md)
  : Describe the inoculation layout of a plate

- [`plot_melanization_map()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/plot_melanization_map.md)
  : Melanization landscape: 3D shaded surface and 2D map of a plate

- [`plot_profiles()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/plot_profiles.md)
  : Plot edge-to-centre melanization profiles

- [`plot_qc()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/plot_qc.md) :
  Quality-control figure

- [`plot_treatment_comparison()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/plot_treatment_comparison.md)
  : Plot plate-level darkness and matched melanization coefficients

- [`prepare_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/prepare_experiment.md)
  : Prepare photographs as an experiment project

- [`prepare_photo_archive()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/prepare_photo_archive.md)
  : Extract and locate the photographs required by metadata

- [`print(`*`<funmel_result>`*`)`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/print_funmel.md)
  [`print(`*`<funmel_classifier>`*`)`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/print_funmel.md)
  [`print(`*`<funmel_layout>`*`)`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/print_funmel.md)
  [`print(`*`<funmel_plate>`*`)`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/print_funmel.md)
  : Print a FunMel object summary

- [`read_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/read_experiment.md)
  : Read saved experiment tables

- [`read_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/read_plate.md)
  : Read a plate photograph

- [`run_experiment()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/run_experiment.md)
  : Analyze all photographs in a prepared experiment

- [`sample_colony_spots()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/sample_colony_spots.md)
  : Sample a chosen number of circular spots within each target colony

- [`segment_colonies()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/segment_colonies.md)
  : Separate Zymoseptoria targets and the central fungal colony

- [`simulate_plate()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/simulate_plate.md)
  : Simulate a plate photograph with known ground truth

- [`srgb_to_lab()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/srgb_to_lab.md)
  :

  Convert sRGB values to CIE 1976 L*a*b\*

- [`train_classifier()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/train_classifier.md)
  : Train a supervised pixel classifier

- [`validate_metadata()`](https://mghotbi.github.io/FunMel/reference/validate_metadata.md)
  : Validate the plate-to-set metadata used for matched controls
